newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich hopes for US budget, tax agreement soon.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich hopes for US budget, tax agreement soon.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Thursday he hoped an agreement on budget and tax bills would be reached "very shortly" between Congress and the White House.

"Hopefully ... very, very shortly we will be able to unveil to the American people an agreement between the Congress and the president in a bill that we could send down maybe by the end of next week ... so that we really could have the first tax cut in 16 years and the first balanced budget in 33," Gingrich said at a press conference.

The Georgia Republican said he met with Senate leadership in the morning and there was a possibility that "real progress" would be made in the next few days to help the District of Columbia. That would include "the kind of tax relief that we believe will help create jobs and help bring working folks back into the city," he said.
